subject: Request: on-demand privacy evidence + secure transfer playbook
messages:
From: Sylvia Carter <sylvia.carter@northbridge.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@northbridge.com
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0500
Subject: Evidence on-demand & transfer method (DPA queries)

Hi Logan —

Thanks for taking our call yesterday. Legal has a few follow-ups so we can close procurement:

1) Audit rights — we need to confirm the process for on-site vs. remote evidence review. Will Redwood provide a reproducible audit package (Art. 30 ledger, subprocessor list, processing purposes) and either allow remote access to logs or accept a third-party SOC-style evidence review?

2) DPIA & Art. 28/30 extracts — can you supply a redacted DPIA summary and the DPA clauses (Art 28+30) that specify subprocessor obligations? We only need excerpts relevant to cross-border transfers and subprocessors.

3) Secure transfer/playbook — our ops wants to know recommended secure transfer patterns for bulk evidence (SFTP vs. HTTPS-upload to a pre-provisioned bucket) and an example SFTP log format we can consume.

If you can send the evidence checklist and a short playbook we can route this to procurement/legal and complete our review. If easier, we can put a 30-minute call on the calendar next week.

Appreciate it —
Sylvia
Sylvia Carter
Head of Vendor Risk, Northbridge Bank

From: logan.wright@redwood.ai
To: Sylvia Carter <sylvia.carter@northbridge.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Evidence on-demand & transfer method (DPA queries)

Sylvia —

Thanks, and great to speak yesterday. Looping in Kimberly (Legal) and Aditya (Security/Infra) so we can get the right artifacts. Quick answers in-line, and we’ll follow up with files:

• Audit rights: Redwood supports remote evidence review by default. We prepare a pre-packaged audit bundle (Art. 30 ledger, subprocessor table, retention schedules, redacted DPIA executive summary) and a live session option where we provide temporary read-only access to our internal evidence portal. On-site audits are supported for enterprise Dedicated/Private customers under the DPA addendum — for hosted customers we arrange a controlled remote review instead.

• DPIA & Art. 28/30: We can provide a redacted DPIA executive summary plus the specific DPA language that maps to Art. 28 responsibilities (subprocessor flow-down, security controls, subprocessors list update cadence) and Art. 30 processing records.

• Transfer/playbook: Aditya — can you add recommended transfer methods and an SFTP log sample? Our usual pattern is pre-signed HTTPS upload to a customer-owned bucket for large datasets, or SFTP over a dedicated connection for customers that require it. We’ll include a sample SFTP log format and a short playbook.

We’ll attach the initial bundle and a one-page playbook in a follow-up within 48 hours. If helpful, propose Tue or Wed next week for a 30-minute walk-through.

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
To: Sylvia Carter <sylvia.carter@northbridge.com>, logan.wright@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:36:00 -05:00
Subject: RE: Evidence on-demand & transfer method (DPA queries)

Hi Sylvia —

Attaching a scoped set of materials we can share immediately: a redacted DPIA executive summary, the DPA excerpt that references Art. 28 obligations, and our current subprocessor registry snapshot. Please note the registry is provided as a snapshot; per the DPA we update customers 30 days prior to on-boarding any new subprocessor that materially affects data flows.

A few legal clarifications:
- Remote evidence review: we provide a sealed audit package and can host a secure remote review session; any additional follow-up requests are handled through an agreed scope and timeline.
- On-site audits: supported only under an addendum for Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Third-party assessor: we accept qualified third-party assessors under NDA; assessor onboarding must follow our vendor access policy (we will coordinate access windows and scope).

I’ve added a short documented process for remote evidence delivery to the Drive link (see related_links) and attached a checklist titled 'on-demand-evidence-playbook-v1.docx'. That checklist includes the items procurement typically asks for and expected lead times.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-dpa-excerpt.pdf; on-demand-evidence-playbook-v1.docx

From: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
To: Sylvia Carter <sylvia.carter@northbridge.com>, kimberly.park@redwood.ai, logan.wright@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 14:08:00 -05:00
Subject: RE: Evidence on-demand & transfer method (DPA queries)

Hi all —

Operational notes to supplement Kimberly’s legal pack:

1) Transfer modes we support for evidence delivery:
  - HTTPS pre-signed upload to a customer-owned bucket (preferred for large exports; least operational friction).
  - SFTP into a dedicated, ephemeral account (SFTP over SSH, key-based auth). We rotate keys per transfer window and provide an ops manifest.
  - Secure portal download: short-lived signed URLs in our evidence portal with IP restrictions.

2) SFTP log sample: attached sftp-log-sample.csv. It contains columns we can supply: timestamp_utc, username, source_ip, filename, transfer_bytes, duration_ms, md5_checksum. We redact internal hostnames.

3) Retention & reproducibility: our export tooling records the model, dataset slice, timestamp, job id, and checksums. For audit requests we include an artifacts index and a processing manifest (matches Art. 30 ledger entries).

4) Scheduling & SLAs: for an on-demand bundle we can deliver within 5 business days for hosted customers (typical) or 3 business days for Dedicated contracts with the audit addendum. Any expedited requests can be quoted.

I’ve attached a small sample log and will push the artifact manifest to the Drive folder Kimberly linked. Happy to run through a sample transfer in a short call if helpful.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Infrastructure Security Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: sftp-log-sample.csv

From: Martin Faye <martin.faye@northbridge.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Sylvia Carter <sylvia.carter@northbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:21:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Evidence on-demand & transfer method (DPA queries)

Team —

Thanks for the clear responses and the attachments. The log sample and playbook look good; procurement asked that we confirm the 5-business-day standard for hosted customers — that timeline is acceptable.

We’d like to schedule the 30-minute walkthrough on Wednesday 11/11 at 10:00 AM ET. Please confirm and we’ll send a calendar invite. Also, could you include a one-line summary in the invite describing the artifacts you’ll demo (e.g., "live remote evidence bundle: Art. 30 ledger excerpt, subprocessor registry snapshot, SFTP sample log").

Appreciate your responsiveness.

Martin
Senior Procurement Manager, Northbridge Bank
